title: Scope node (cascade)
description: arch §3.1: five nested scopes (company → division → org → team → individual), each holding three object types — context, profile, experience. An agent's working context = composition of its path down the tree, narrower overriding broader (CLAUDE.md-style cascade). The adapter maps the harness cascade (enterprise/project/user CLAUDE.md) onto these nodes.

scope_id.description: Stable id of the scope node

parent_scope_id.description: The enclosing scope (null at company level)

context.description: Entry ids/paths of context objects at this level — what exists and matters here (§3.1)

profile.description: Entry ids/paths of profile objects — role/relationships/priorities/voice at individual scope; roster/ownership/rituals at team scope (§3.1)

experience.description: Entry ids/paths of experience objects — output conventions per scope (§3.1)

disclosure_default.description: §3.2.3: scope sets disclosure defaults (same-team free; cross-org hits explicit policy)
